en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al hakam, from Al Rabie Al Musally, for Marouf Bin Kharbouz,
(It has been narrated) from the one who saw Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> eating the bread with the grapes’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from al- Rabi ‘ al-Musliy from Ma‘ruf ibn Kharrabudh from those who had seen ’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, eating bread with grapes.”
